name: itfreesource-academy-book-store
description: ITFreeSource Academy Book Store - Fullstack TypeScript Platform with React SPA, Swagger OpenAPI 3.0, RBAC, and QA Automation Playground
author: ITFreeSource Academy

scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix server install --prefer-offline --no-audit && npm --prefix client install --prefer-offline --no-audit
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')){fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/200.html');}}"
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')){fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/200.html');}}"
